layers.label: Overall score
layers.note: Weighted mean of your 10 criteria (water 15, price 12, soil 10, drive 8, access 6, fire 5, wellness 4, hazards 3, war 2, unrest 1; price idle until listings), minus 10 in Natura 2000, natural parks and nature reserves. Only land kept by the rule-out is scored.

layers.label: Water score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Drive score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Fire safety score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Soil & climate score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: War safety score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Unrest safety score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Mining safety score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Access score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Wellness score
layers.note: Criterion score 0–100 from the curves in config/criteria.yaml (scoring).

layers.label: Community score (estate mode)
layers.note: Estate-mode score for the community track: water 15, place 10, soil 8, fire 8, land price 8, wellness 6, airport 4, schools 4, private hospital 4, drive 4, hazards 3; Natura/parks −10. Weights in config estate_mode. Kept land only.

layers.label: Farmland price (region)
layers.note: Eurostat 2024 farmland price by NUTS2 region (mean of arable and grassland). Regional average only.

layers.label: Drive to Lisbon airport
layers.note: Free-flow drive minutes to Humberto Delgado airport (OSM roads).

layers.label: Drive to new airport site
layers.note: Planned Luís de Camões airport (Campo de Tiro de Alcochete, ~2034). Today's roads.

layers.label: Drive to international school
layers.note: Nearest school with an international/foreign curriculum in OSM (name match, incomplete).

layers.label: Drive to private hospital
layers.note: Nearest private hospital in OSM (CUF, Lusíadas, Luz, Trofa…; incomplete).

layers.label: Drive to high-speed station
layers.note: Nearest open/under-construction/planned high-speed or airport-link station (Évora, Caia, airport, Oriente, Leiria-Barosa, Coimbra, Aveiro, Gaia, Porto). Dates 2027–2036; sites partly approximate.

layers.label: Drive to train station today
layers.note: Nearest station or halt in service (IP 2023).

layers.label: Distance to railway line
layers.note: Railway lines in service (dados.gov.pt, Apr 2026). Noise screening; the Linha do Sul carries growing Sines freight.

layers.label: Relief within 1 km
layers.note: Height difference within 1 km: valleys and hills read as more varied land.

layers.label: South-facing share
layers.note: Share of land within 300 m that faces south (slope ≥3%).

layers.label: Native woodland nearby
layers.note: Cork, holm and other oaks, chestnut, broadleaves and montado within 500 m (COS 2025).

layers.label: Lake-site valleys
layers.note: Share of land within 500 m that is a side valley with a 20–2,000 ha catchment: places a pond or lake could fill.

layers.label: Fire fuel within 2 km
layers.note: Forest and shrubland within 2 km, with the east side (hot east-wind days) counted double.

layers.label: July heat 2041–60
layers.note: Mean daily maximum in July, 2041–2060, moderate scenario, adjusted for elevation.

layers.label: January cold 2041–60
layers.note: Mean daily minimum in January, 2041–2060. Valley frost pockets are colder than shown.

layers.label: Distance to a village
layers.note: Distance to the nearest INE 2021 settlement.

layers.label: Drive time from Lisbon
layers.note: Free-flow drive time on OSM roads from Marquês de Pombal. No traffic, so real times run longer.

layers.label: Annual rainfall
layers.note: CHELSA 1981–2010 modelled climatology, about 1 km.

layers.label: Aridity index
layers.note: Rainfall ÷ potential evapotranspiration. Below 0.5 is semi-arid.

layers.label: Aridity 2041–2060
layers.note: Projected for 2041–2060 under the moderate scenario (SSP2-4.5): today's CHELSA aridity × median change across 24 climate models (WorldClim CMIP6). Below 0.5 is ruled out.

layers.label: Aquifer productivity
layers.note: APA Atlas do Ambiente, 1:1M. Median productivity of the aquifer class.

layers.label: Distance to any stream
layers.note: OSM rivers, streams and canals plus APA rivers. Many streams are seasonal.

layers.label: Distance to river
layers.note: Rivers and canals only (OSM + APA).

layers.label: Springs within 2 km
layers.note: OSM springs plus APA mineral springs. OSM coverage is patchy: none mapped is not none there.

layers.label: Fire hazard class
layers.note: SRUP Carta de Perigosidade de Incêndio Rural (2022). Mean class per hectare; 5 = muito alta.

layers.label: Fires per decade
layers.note: ICNF burned-area maps 1975–2025. Pre-1990 records cover large fires only.

layers.label: Eucalyptus + maritime pine
layers.note: COS 2025 land use. High-fuel plantations.

layers.label: Soil capability
layers.note: SROA land capability via APA Atlas, 1:1M. Coarse; check per parcel.

layers.label: Slope
layers.note: Copernicus 30 m DSM, mean slope per hectare.

layers.label: Elevation
layers.note: Copernicus 30 m DSM.

layers.label: Distance to coast
layers.note: Straight-line distance to the sea.

layers.label: Distance to military sites
layers.note: OSM military areas plus COS 2025 military infrastructure.

layers.label: Distance to ports
layers.note: OSM ports plus COS port terminals and shipyards.

layers.label: Distance to energy sites
layers.note: Power plants, refineries, substations ≥150 kV (OSM + COS).

layers.label: Population within 30 km
layers.note: Census 2021 1 km grid, Portugal and Spain. Log colour scale.

layers.label: Distance to city ≥ 50k
layers.note: EU urban-centre rule on the census grid: ≥1,500/km², ≥50,000 people.

layers.label: Distance to motorway
layers.note: OSM motorways and trunk roads.

layers.label: Natura 2000
layers.note: ZEC + ZPE sites (ICNF).

layers.label: Protected areas (RNAP)
layers.note: National network of protected areas (ICNF).

layers.label: Flood risk zone
layers.note: APA T20/T100 risk areas. Mapped river stretches only.

layers.label: RAN (farm reserve)
layers.note: DGT legal register (SRUP): Reserva Agrícola Nacional. New building is restricted unless a building already exists.

layers.label: REN (ecological reserve)
layers.note: DGT legal register (SRUP): Reserva Ecológica Nacional, downloaded per concelho for land kept after rule-out.

layers.label: Buildability
layers.note: Screening only, not legal advice: likely = existing building, settlement or registered urbano article; unlikely = mostly RAN without a building, REN, flood, fire class 4–5, water. Unknown = needs the câmara's PDM.

layers.label: Ruins (OSM)
layers.note: Buildings tagged as ruins in OpenStreetMap. LiDAR wall detection comes later for top zones.

layers.label: Distance to mining
layers.note: DGEG: active concessions and approved exploration areas. Within 1 km of an active concession is ruled out.

layers.label: Distance to pending mining applications
layers.note: DGEG applications not yet decided (pedido, em publicação, reservada).

layers.label: Drive to A&E
layers.note: Minutes to the nearest hospital with an emergency department (OSM). Over 45 min scores 0.

layers.label: Nuisance nearby
layers.note: Quarries, landfills, intensive livestock, wind turbines, aerodromes and the new Alcochete airport zone, each fading to 0 at its buffer (2–10 km).

layers.label: Intensive farming within 1 km
layers.note: Spray-drift risk: high-density olive and orchards, greenhouses, rice (COS 2025).

layers.label: Radon potential
layers.note: Proxy from geology: 3 = granite. Mitigable in design; scored lightly, never ruled out.

layers.label: Distance to irrigation perimeter
layers.note: DGT legal irrigation perimeters (134). Most of Alqueva is not in this register.

layers.label: Rule-out (step 2)
layers.note: Your step 2 filters. Each hectare shows the first filter it fails; the percentages are the share of mainland coloured that way. Natura 2000 and natural parks are not blocked: they get a score penalty in step 3.
